'''Aburrey Gauntlets''' is a {{gear|4|Gloves}}gear item.

{{Item description|Designed by Triglava Armoury and assembled by the AIC. This equipment improves the wearer's combat capabilities.|Novel protective equipment modified for the work environment of the Aburrey Quarry. 
Hand protection linked to the protective armor suit. The fingertips have been furnished with nearly 100 micro-sensors of 6 different types to help wearers accurately determine what they actually touched — even after losing their sight.}}
